visual.name: upsetVenn
visual.description: Set overlap that tells the truth: area-proportional Venn/Euler for 1-3 sets (circles or best-fit ellipses) with an honest fit badge, classic Venn for 4-5 sets, an UpSet matrix for more, long, delimited, wide or pre-aggregated data, % of base with 'none of these', any/all/exactly selection. Premium Overlap intelligence: survey weights, confidence intervals, significance, duplication matrix, TURF reach, wave comparison. Part of the SmartVisuals family.
